fl.name: Florida (statewide)
fl.bounds: Every Florida migratory bird season is statewide. Seasons and dates may not apply on wildlife management areas.
fl.note: One zone. Leon County, Lake Miccosukee and part of the Hernando County Gulf limit waterfowl to Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays (amber).

seasonsNote: Every season is statewide; WMAs set their own. In Leon County and on Lake Miccosukee waterfowl hunting is Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays (plus listed holidays) during the regular duck season.

seasons.label: Teal and wood ducks — September
seasons.note: Teal and wood ducks only; no more than 2 wood ducks in the 6.

seasons.label: Common gallinules (moorhens)
seasons.note: Purple gallinules may not be taken.

bags.detail: Six ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily bag.
Inside the 6: no more than 3 scoters, long-tailed ducks or eiders, and no more than 1 hen eider.
Ducks, light geese, Canada geese, mergansers, coots and common gallinules at the regular limits; scaup 2.

duckSublimits.note: 1 Nov 21–29 and Dec 12 – Jan 11; 2 from Jan 12 and on youth and veterans days
no more than 3 scoters, long-tailed ducks or eiders; 1 hen eider

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise until sunset.

Waterfowl hunting only on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays during the regular duck season (Nov 21–29, Dec 12 – Jan 31), plus Nov 26–27, Dec 24–25 and 31, and Jan 1 and 18. Lake Talquin and the Ochlockonee River are open every day of the regular duck season. Amber on the map.
Ducks, geese and coots only on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays in the state waters of the Gulf in Hernando County north of Raccoon Point and east of Saddle Key, as posted. Not drawn.

During the regular duck season: no internal combustion engines on Lake Iamonia (except by permit) or Carr Lake, and none over 10 hp on Lake Miccosukee (motors and airboats allowed in September and on youth and veterans days). No hunting from or within 30 yards of a permanent duck blind on Lake Miccosukee and lakes Iamonia, Jackson and Carr.
No taking ducks, geese or coots while possessing any shot other than approved non-toxic shot.
Recorded or electronic calls are prohibited for migratory birds (and for all game in Florida).
No taking of harlequin ducks, brant or purple gallinules.
Statewide seasons and dates may not apply on WMAs; each area’s regulations brochure sets its waterfowl days.
Youth days Nov 14, 2026 and Feb 13, 2027 (15 and under, with a non-hunting adult 18+). Veterans and active-duty military, National Guard and Reserves: Feb 6–7, 2027.

rules.t: Keep a wing on; tag birds left with others
rules.d: Head or one fully feathered wing stays on (except doves) until home or a processor; birds left with anyone else need a signed tag.

licences.d: Annual hunting licence $17 resident, $79 non-resident (or a Sportsman’s licence).
Or the E-Stamp; valid July 1 – June 30.
